title: The Executable Constitution
subtitle: A civilization whose law is a replay
description: An offline constitutional simulator where laws, amendments, offices, resources, logical beats, and actions are append-only canonical SHA-256 frames.
claim: One shared semantic validator can make an append-only constitutional frame chain executable: current law gates civic action, ranked logical-beat leases transfer authority, lawful forks preserve their shared history, and replay contains a correctly hashed unconstitutional write at its exact violated law.
invariants: Every frame is hashed with browser Web Crypto SHA-256 over recursively key-sorted canonical JSON and linked to the exact predecessor hash.
All visible laws, offices, resources, logical beats, and actions are reconstructed only by replaying frames.
The same semantic transition validator gates both append and independent replay.
Spending requires the current steward, sufficient resources, the authorized purpose and amount, and an active cited appropriation.
Appointments and stewardship transfer follow the active ranked succession law and its logical-beat lease plus rank grace.
Every amendment cites the active law it supersedes, and later actions may not cite the superseded law.
Forked societies preserve an identical constitutional prefix and append different lawful descendants without rewriting either history.
Replay stops at the first invalid frame, names the exact violated law, and retains the last valid derived society.
positive_path: Run the guided history to spend under the founding appropriation, appoint the next-ranked deputy, and amend the spending law.
Observe an attempted action under the superseded law refused before append, then spend under the active replacement.
Fail the steward, advance the logical clock to the ranked lease gate, and transfer authority to the first eligible successor.
Fork from a constitutional frame and compare two independently replayable societies with the same immutable prefix.
failure_path: Use the tyrant mutation to bypass append validation and inject a correctly hashed spend under LAW-TREASURY-1 after LAW-TREASURY-2 supersedes it. Independent replay rejects that exact law citation at the injected frame while the last valid society remains visible.
